title: Mem2A error
description: Why memory refused, or why it could not accept a message. Sent by memory as a data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.error+json`) in a status message.

message.description: A plain-language explanation. MUST NOT reveal facts the principal cannot see.

currentVersion.description: For `stale-dossier`: the task's current dossier version.
